description: This file implements the MediaPipelineClient class, which handles IPC communication for media pipeline events such as playback state, network state, position, QoS, and media data requests within the Rialto media framework. It includes methods to send various event notifications via an IPC client, and contains conversion functions for playback and network states.

classes.name: MediaPipelineClient
classes.description: A class responsible for sending media pipeline related events over IPC, such as playback state, network state, position, QoS, and media data requests.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Logs a warning that duration notification is not supported.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Sends a position change event with the current position.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Logs a warning that native size notification is not supported.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Sends a network state change event.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Sends a playback state change event.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Logs a warning that video data notification is not supported.

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Logs a warning that audio data notification is not supported.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Sends a request for media data, including shared memory info.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Logs a warning that cancel media data request is not supported.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Sends a QoS event with processed and dropped data counts.
